As its near-term management strategy, the company is working on three initiatives: strengthening earnings capacity, strengthening its management foundation and strengthening overall group capabilities. Its stated challenges include establishing a robust earnings base less affected by changes in the external environment, expanding new businesses and business areas, realizing sustainability and maximizing the value of human capital, and ensuring food safety and responding to unforeseen circumstances.
